messages:
sam: Heads-up — saw a perf regression in nightly perf-run for seqlen=512, batch=2 on A100. Runtime picked the generic 'attn_fallback' kernel instead of the arch-optimized path and latency jumped ~18ms. Anyone seen this pattern before?

irene: Ugh. Did the telemetry include the pick_reason payload? we recently changed how seq-buckets are computed, might be falling into a weird bucket.

sam: I have the telemetry dump, pasted below. Note the env was RK_PICK_DEBUG=0 in the job.

sam: ```json
{
  "request_id": "job-2026-03-17-512b2",
  "model": "redwood-7b-v1",
  "hw_arch": "sm80",
  "seq_len": 512,
  "batch_size": 2,
  "kv_cache": { "hits": 0, "misses": 0 },
  "kernel_chosen": "attn_fallback",
  "candidates": [
    {"name": "fused_attn_sm80", "score": 78, "reason_codes": ["arch_ok","latency_est_high"]},
    {"name": "fused_attn_generic", "score": 85, "reason_codes": ["score_tiebreaker","batch_small"]},
    {"name": "attn_fallback", "score": 120, "reason_codes": ["no_kernel_ready","autotune_disabled"]}
  ],
  "pick_env_flags": "RK_PICK_DEBUG=0;RK_SEQ_BUCKETS=128,256,1024",
  "observed_latency_ms": 45.2
}
```

irene: Interesting that RK_SEQ_BUCKETS only had 1024 as high bucket — missing 512. That would push 512 into the 256 or 1024 path depending on the bucket logic. If 512 maps to 1024 bucket and we have a stale autotune entry for 1024 that prefers fallback kernel, that explains it.

maria: Can you repro locally with RK_PICK_DEBUG=1 and RK_PICK_LOG_LEVEL=trace? There's also RK_KV_PREFETCH=1 toggle that changed in the autoscaler image last week and might affect readiness of the fused kernel.

sam: Reproduced with debug flags on. Trace shows kernel scoring short-circuit when 'kernel_ready' check failed because prefetch thread didn't populate a readiness flag in time. snippet:```
[trace] check_ready(fused_attn_sm80) -> false (prefetch_timeout=8ms)
[trace] score(fused_attn_sm80) -> 78
[trace] short_circuit -> pick attn_fallback
```

chris: That aligns with the change I deployed (prefetch thread backoff to reduce overhead). Prefetch backoff could be causing intermittent readiness failures for small batches. We need a guard: if score delta between arch-optimized and fallback is > X, don't short-circuit on transient readiness miss.

maria: action items: (1) chris revert prefetch backoff variant on canary today; (2) sam run a conv test matrix with RK_PICK_DEBUG=1 across seq buckets 256/512/1024 and attach traces; (3) irene add a telemetry histogram for "ready_latency_ms" per kernel.

chris: I'll schedule the revert and post the canary link. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: nightly-perf: regression detected for job-2026-03-17-512b2 (delta +18.4ms). Alert assigned to @chris and @sam.

sam: Thanks — I'll upload the full trace artifacts to the perf bucket and link here when done.

irene: Also let's add a small change to the pick logic: when autotune disabled, prefer last-known-good kernel if score within 10%. That should reduce noise until autotune entries warm up.

maria: +1. we should also surface the pick rationale in the console (short string) so SREs can triage without digging into logs.

sam: Uploaded traces -> gs://redwood-perf/traces/job-2026-03-17-512b2/trace.tar.gz

chris: Revert deployed to canary (region-us-west2), will monitor.

sam: Can confirm canary latency back to baseline after revert. Closing the loop for now.

maria: We'll keep the telemetry change and pick-guard patch in the next runtime release. Leaving task in the runtime backlog: R-4232.
